notes: Held-out plan added 2026-10-29 to test generalisation: a 112-page scanned 2004 basin plan from the same MDEQ series as Buttahatchee (a tuning plan), but for another watershed. Drafted by Claude from the page images before any extraction of this plan was run; quotes are transcribed by eye, so the verbatim and quote checks do not apply. Labelled like the Buttahatchee answer key: the goals-and-actions table (page 3) and sections 3.1-3.3.1 (pages 17-18). Here the list of actions starts at the top of page 18 under a lead-in on page 17, and its sub-items are marked with diamonds.
